record.field: Create Transit Picking Types for Warehouse

# records = new src backorder pickings that just became 'assigned' # Find their PARENT transit pickings via backorder_id parent_transit_pickings = env['transit.picking'].search([ ('src_picking_id', 'in', records.mapped('backorder_id').ids) ])
if parent_transit_pickings: parent_transit_pickings.automation_handle_src_backorder_created(records)

# records = new dest backorder pickings (incoming, with backorder_id set, move_ids present) # Find parent transit pickings whose dest_picking_id = the parent picking (backorder_id) parent_transit_pickings = env['transit.picking'].search([ ('dest_picking_id', 'in', records.mapped('backorder_id').ids) ])
if parent_transit_pickings: parent_transit_pickings.automation_handle_dest_backorder_created(records)
